needed.evidence: A grassy verge and a steep embankment rise directly from the road edge, with no path or pavement for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, paved footway on the left side, separated from the carriageway by a grass verge.

needed.evidence: The right side of the road has a shoulder and a guardrail, but no dedicated path for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Install a paved footway on the right side, set back from the guardrail to provide a safe walking surface.

needed.evidence: The road is wide with four lanes and a painted median, and there are no marked or signalised crossings visible in any frame.
needed.suggestion: Provide a signalised pedestrian crossing with a central refuge island to allow safe crossing of the multi-lane road.

needed.evidence: There are no street lights visible along the length of the road in any of the frames.
needed.suggestion: Install a series of street lights along both sides of the road to improve visibility for all road users.
